# Restart timing fixture provenance

The wall-coordinate file is an unchanged copy of codex01's CPU producer fixture
`codex01-chaos-read-restart-27-review-20261031/budget-disconnect.json`: 480 GETs,
236 completed failures, generated by the real pack CLI/accepted worker over a
fake connector and deterministic clock. It is not hardware evidence.

The monotonic-coordinate copy subtracts 1800000000 and adds 1000 from only the
read-stage bounds, first/last success and failure timestamps. Existing outcomes,
IDs, counts, counters and payload fields are unchanged. This is the new unified
read-stage contract; the seed's separate wall-time metadata is unaffected.

The original marker1030 no longer qualifies: window close is after1090. This
case is retained as `old-marker-budget-exceeded`. The full-shaped positive uses
marker1032.75 (the trace's success immediately before the first error), so the
same 59.25-second window fits [marker,marker+60]. This marker input change is
explicit, not a workload or byte/count-floor retune. All three reviewer negative
mutations are retained in the unified coordinate, plus zero-error and joined
shift-beyond-load controls.

The joined-shift negative also shifts the supplied marker by20, preserving
window eligibility while leaving the original load bounds unchanged. It thus
isolates the absolute-load-bracket check from the marker+60 check.
